Hi Elena — thanks for sending these over and for the call. A few items we need to complete procurement setup and to pass to finance/legal: 

1) Certificate/endorsement: Redwood requires an Additional Insured endorsement on the GL certificate naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." (address: 1350 Market St, San Francisco, CA) and the policy must include Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood where available. For cyber / E&O we require limits of at least $1,000,000 and a statement that the insurer will provide 30 days notice of cancellation.

2) Subcontractors: please confirm the subcontractor list is complete and whether any of those subs will handle customer data/credentials. If so, we may need the subs added to the COI or an equivalent attestation.

3) Billing & PO: please send invoices to accounts-payable@redwood.com. Procurement can issue a provisional PO if some endorsement language is pending — need confirmation from procurement/legal (cc'd).

4) W9 looks fine, thanks.

I've attached our procurement intake form to fill the remaining fields (contact for invoices, tax id, preferred remit). If you can get the insurer to confirm endorsement language or send the insurer contact, that will speed things up.

I'll loop in Irene to confirm provisional PO path.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin

Thanks for the ping — procurement can issue a provisional PO (PO_1284_provisional.pdf attached) for up to 30 days net-30 while the endorsement is processed, with the following conditions: 

- Payment hold clause: final invoice release contingent on delivery of the Additional Insured endorsement and Waiver of Subrogation as specified.
- Provisional amount: 50% of first month charges; remainder held until endorsement received.
- If endorsement not received within 30 days, PO will convert to hold and payments will be stopped until remediation.

Accounting instructions: invoices should be sent to accounts-payable@redwood.com, reference PO #1284. Please include remittance details on the invoice.

Monica, from a legal perspective the conditional PO with the hold clause is acceptable for standard SaaS onboarding; we should require the endorsement and 30 days notice of cancellation. If Discovery confirms DataSage has no access to PII, we do not need them added to the COI, but we do need a subcontractor attestation email on Discoverys letterhead.

Elena — once you confirm you authorize the insurer to issue the endorsement and provide the subcontractor attestation, procurement will finalize the provisional PO and route to accounts-payable for payment.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
